verdicts.reason: A drops the light-blue panel behind the illustration, so the artwork floats on white, and two pale-blue blocks are left stranded at the bottom as meaningless fragments. It also leaves a big empty band at the top, the chevrons sit far from 'YOUR EFFICIENT' (which now wraps onto two lines), and the pipes run off the right edge. B keeps the blue panel, so it stays closer to the original, but the pipes still stick out past the panel to the canvas edge, a stray blue strip sits in the bottom-left corner, and it has the same empty top area, awkward kicker wrap and detached chevrons.
